description: Pending Replies (Inbox): save a reply the user owes someone, e.g. 'what to reply to X', 'I owe X a reply'. Use this, not log_event or a task. Optional draft (the reply text), summary (one line in your own words; never the email body, subject or sender), channel, category, received_at, and source { kind, thread_id, message_id } (ids only). Links the contact only when resolve_person finds exactly one (or pass person_id); otherwise the reply is saved unlinked and person_link says why. An unsent reply for the same thread or person comes back instead of a second one (created: false, deduplicated: true); update_existing: true replaces its draft and summary. Never sends anything. Requires API key or OAuth with context.write; share tokens cannot write. ($0.10; API key required)

channel.description: Where to reply: whatsapp, email, sms, call, imessage, telegram, instagram, facebook, signal, linkedin, twitter, slack, teams, work_email, zoom, dayze, other. Default email when source is set, else other.

draft.description: The reply text to send later, max 20,000 characters. Replaces the saved draft; empty or null clears. Alias: draft_message.

person_id.description: An owned contact id; links that contact directly.

person_name.description: Who the reply is owed to, as the user said it (e.g. "Ilana").

received_at.description: When they wrote (ISO date-time). Default now.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

source.description: The email the reply answers, as ids only (e.g. a search_gmail id is a message_id). Never a subject, sender or text. On update, null clears it.

summary.description: One line (max 280) in your own words: what the reply is about. Never paste the email body, subject line or sender address.

update_existing.description: When an unsent reply for this thread or person exists, write draft/summary onto it instead of returning it unchanged.

name: create_pending_reply

created.description: True when this call saved a new reply.

deduplicated.description: True when an unsent reply for the same thread or person was returned instead of a new one.

matched_on.description: source_thread, source_message or person when deduplicated.

person_link.description: Whether a contact was linked. Linked only on one resolve_person match or an owned person_id.

reply.description: One reply the user owes (Inbox → Pending Replies). Dayze never sends it.

draft.description: The reply text saved for later.

due.description: Owed now: pending, or snoozed with snooze_until passed. False while a snooze runs, and when sent or dismissed.

person_id.description: Linked contact id; null when the reply is unlinked.

source.description: The email it answers, as ids only; null when none was saved.

state.description: unsent (pending or snoozed), sent (the owner replied) or dismissed

source_saved.description: False when a source was given and could not be stored.

updated.description: True when an existing unsent reply was changed (update_existing).

title: Create Pending Reply
